title: Small channels improve the same full Gibbs law without truncation
statement: Separate exact P4/P6/P8 channels and retain all P>=10 words to obtain Gamma_compact about7.947236839e-7. Then1<=Zaux/wminus<=expGamma<=1/(1-Gamma)<1.000001. Conditioning envelope nonemptiness and rejecting empty retained draws acquires the full nonempty-core law with stated acceptance>.04. This is a finite auxiliary-law/normalizer result, not a flux normalizer or uniform growing-r rejection theorem.
